description:
Send a document via email in Holded.

Args:
  - doc_type (string): Document type (required)
  - document_id (string): The document ID to send (required)
  - emails (string): Recipient email(s), comma-separated (required)
  - subject (string): Email subject
  - message (string): Email message body

Returns:
  Confirmation of sending.

doc_type.description: Document type: invoice, salesreceipt, creditnote, receiptnote, estimate, salesorder, waybill, proform, purchase, purchaserefund, purchaseorder

name: holded_invoicing_send_document
title: Send Holded Document
